title: plugin-approvals: `sys_approval_request` has no parent-record read gate on the data door, and the ruled record-reader tier cannot be switched on by an app (17.7.0)
body:
Filing class: ① product defect — reach: public door (`GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request`), measured on 17.7.0. Possible data exposure for any app that grants read on the object.

**Reader:** objectstack triage → the lane owning `plugin-approvals` / the data door's per-object read gates.

## Symptom

Measured in `objectstack-ai/hotclm` while fixing objectstack-ai/hotclm#86 (draft PR objectstack-ai/hotclm#88, report on #86). The app's contract page has an Approvals tab: a `record:related_list` over `sys_approval_request`, the shape `DESIGN.md` declares for a record's approval history.

1. **Without an app grant:** every non-admin caller gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on `sys_approval_request` (the `member_default` baseline names it nowhere), so the tab is blank for the audiences it exists for.
2. **With an app grant of `allowRead`** (temporary, never committed): the data door applies **no parent-record scoping**. Three requesters, each owning private contracts the others cannot open, each listed **every** approval request in the organization (`total=2`). `GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request/ID` of another owner's request answered `200` with the payload snapshot (`contract_number`, `amount: 447000`, `risk_level`, `liability_cap`) while `GET /api/v1/data/clm_contract/ID` of that contract answered `404` to the same caller.
3. **The ruled alternative is unreachable.** The record-reader visibility tier ruled on `objectstack-ai/objectstack#8652` lives only on `/api/v1/approvals/*`, behind `ApprovalsServicePlugin`'s constructor option `recordReaderVisibleObjects`. The CLI's `serve` constructs that plugin with no arguments (it passes options to automation, analytics, email, sms and storage only), so no app metadata can switch it on — absent on `main` @ `4638625` as well. And no page component reads the approvals door: the owner of a contract sees `total=0` for her own contract's request on `/api/v1/approvals/requests?object=clm_contract&recordId=…`.

## Expected

The same shape the platform already gave `sys_comment`, `sys_activity` (#20833) and `sys_audit_log` (#21069 / #21194): the `sys_approval_request` data door serves a row only when the caller can read the record it is about (`object_name` + `record_id`) — or, equivalently, a record-page component over the approvals door plus a declarative (stack-level) opt-in for `recordReaderVisibleObjects`. Either makes "show this record's approval history to the people who can read the record" expressible without an org-wide grant.

## Minimal repro

Two users each owning a private record of an object with an approval flow; one request per record; grant one of them `allowRead` on `sys_approval_request`; `GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request` as that user → both requests, snapshots included.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, queries `sys_approval_request data door row visibility recordReaderVisibleObjects approval history record page reader` (20 hits) and `sys_approval_request read gate parent record caller can read data route` (12 hits) — none open and none on this: nearest #20833 (closed — the `sys_activity` sibling this asks to mirror), #21984 (closed — Setup's first view), #22211 (closed — action predicates), #8652 (the ruled tier).

---
_Filed by the `repo:hotclm` PM seat from a measured dev finding._
